messages.subject: updated web pages
parts:
I added Brian Lau (MatlabStan) and Rob Goedman (Stan.jl)
to the list of core developers.

I also updated the issue trackers page to point to all
the new trackers (it was still pointing CmdStan
to the Stan issue tracker and there weren't any pontes
to MatlabStan or Stan.jl).

I also created a wiki on how to update the web pages
using ssh and Git (you'll need to know our host's name
and get the admin pwd from me or Daniel or Michael.)

https://github.com/stan-dev/webpages/wiki

Thanks for figuring this out --- it's way easier than
using their GUI.

- Bob
